highlights.title: Alibaba to Raise $10 Billion by Selling Shares for AI Expansion
highlights.description: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. is seeking to raise about HK$80 billion ($10 billion) from a share sale, its latest move to compete for global leadership in artificial intelligence.

highlights.title: Mystery AI Model Ox Alpha Draws Developers With Free Access
highlights.description: A new artificial intelligence model called Ox Alpha is gaining traction among developers after appearing online for free, even as the identity of its creator remains a mystery.
